releaseNotes: v1.9.4: Dashboard issue #24 - Apply Proxy modal made scrollable with pool filter, progress and a working Stop; connection reorder moved to a single atomic server-side call (one transaction, contiguous 1..N) so a failed swap can no longer wedge an account pair forever; NULL connection priority no longer rewritten to 0 by unrelated edits; pinned connections now honour disable/exclusion/model-locks; round-robin is persisted per connection (upstream least-recently-used) and survives restarts. Provider search matches id and alias; qoder-cn registered end to end; bai/atria/dahl/agnes/tokenharbor/qoder-cn logos ported from upstream. Also: Gemini Live realtime STT, Claude session-id/beta/rate-limit header parity, full upstream pricing table, Codex OAuth loopback fix, upstream v0.5.86..v0.5.91 sync (Gemini turns, Claude thinking text, usage by API key).
